voiceTest.instruction5: Hold your device 6-12 cm from your mouth.

drawingTest.title: Drawing Analysis Test :
drawingTest.spiralDescription: Draw a continuous spiral naturally inside the drawing area while keeping your hand movement smooth and stable.
drawingTest.waveDescription: Draw a smooth wave pattern inside the drawing area using a continuous and controlled hand movement.
drawingTest.spiralInstruction1: Draw the spiral freely inside the drawing area using one continuous movement.
drawingTest.spiralInstruction2: Try to keep the spacing between the spiral turns as consistent as possible.
drawingTest.spiralInstruction3: Avoid sudden stops or sharp hand movements while drawing.
drawingTest.waveInstruction1: Draw a continuous wave pattern from one side of the area to the other.
drawingTest.waveInstruction2: Maintain smooth and balanced up-and-down movements while drawing.
drawingTest.waveInstruction3: Try to keep the wave shape stable without abrupt direction changes.
drawingTest.spiralDrawHeaderSubtitle: Draw the spiral naturally inside the canvas area.
drawingTest.waveDrawHeaderSubtitle: Draw the wave pattern smoothly inside the canvas area.
